Priya S: Heads upcandidate for SDE2 (EU) countered. They want earlier start (Apr 5) and asked if we can temporarily match their counter until comp uplift. Need decision today.
Anya (People Ops): quick facts please - current offer and counter (no PII)
Darren (Hiring Manager): Current: base €112k, 10% bonus. Role band top €118k. Counter: €125k. Candidate open to a sign-on or provisional top-up, wants to relocate mid-April.
Nina (Comp): Policy: exceptions possible as "provisional economic uplift" or one-time sign-on. Must be timeboxed and routed to VP + Finance. Clawback terms required if uplift not approved.
offer-bot: Automated check: "Action: provisional top-up OR lump sign-on + start date change. Required approvers: comp@, vp-engi@, finance@. Suggested duration: <= 90 days. Routing ETA: 24h for VP. Candidate deadline: EOD"
Priya S: Can we offer a provisional lump sum (€6k) to bridge to their expectation and confirm earlier start conditional on approvals?
Darren (Hiring Manager): I can cover hiring budget for the lump payment. This hire is high-priority for the infra rollout. I'll include justification in the request.
Nina (Comp): If VP approves, comp will sign off on a 60-day provisional uplift (payable in first payroll) and commit to final band review by 2026-06-01. Must include clawback if candidate leaves before 6 months.
Anya (People Ops): I'll draft the updated offer language: keep base €112k, add one-time provisional payment €6,000 payable on first payroll contingent on start; new proposed start 2026-04-05. Add clause: final comp review by 2026-06-01; repayment clause if uplift not approved. Sending for legal review and VP approval now.
Darren (Hiring Manager): pinging @VP Eng for quick ok; sending candidate a "provisional pending approvals" note so relocation planning can start.
VP Eng: I'll review and reply within 3 hours. If Nina and Finance confirm clawback terms, I approve provisional payment.
Priya S: thanks all, I'll tell candidate we expect final confirmation tomorrow AM and will help with relocation timeline. :thumbsup:
Anya (People Ops): logging this exception in tracker and attaching redacted comp docs.
